# ADR-3026: A03: Shell command string for ops helper 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Shell injection turns input into remote code execution.

## Decision

Services MUST NOT compose a shell command string for ops helper 2 (A03-2).

## Consequences

Prefer argv arrays without a shell.
